Source contracts: install-website.sh

install-website.sh

Shell · Tier B

Prepare the host and deploy or recover the standalone website.

Usage

Run on the Linux website host; arguments pass unchanged to install-website.py. Uses defaults without prompts; add --interactive for settings and administrator questions.

Inputs

An intended checkout; --data-dir selects persistent state outside it. Missing prerequisites are installed on supported Ubuntu/Debian hosts.

Side effects

The child can build images, start containers, back up or restore content, and manage CMS accounts. It uses this checkout without fetching or switching Git.

Cleanup

exec transfers process and signal ownership to the Python installer.
